integrity: An explicit acyclic face-poset matching certifies 2-connectivity; independently, elementary simplicial collapses followed by exact integral unit cancellations certify every homology group. Reproduction script and actual output included.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for the four-dimensional binary hypercube; homotopy wedge splitting, higher attaching maps, and equivariant actions are not established. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Integral homology and two-connectivity of the four-cube perfect-matching complex
